reference.title: Medicine Ball Overhead Slam
reference.listing: Catalog entry only (gymvisual.com not read; blocked by the proxy). Movement from the exercise name and standard coaching.
reference.note: Reference used only to identify the movement. No GymVisual media is stored here; this rig, model and animation are original.

breathing.pattern: Inhale as the ball goes up, exhale forcefully as you slam.
breathing.cadence: About 0.9 s up, 0.6 s slam, 1.8 s pick-up

prescription.progression: Heavier slam ball, or more reps at the same power

cues.text: Stand a little wider than hip width, ball at the chest in both hands.
Breathe in and reach the ball up overhead with long arms.
Breathe out hard and slam the ball to the floor just in front of your feet, hips back, knees bent.
Squat down, pick the ball up with a flat back and stand tall.
Ball back at the chest; repeat.

mistakes.mistake: Slamming with a rounded back only
mistakes.fix: Hinge at the hips and bend the knees; let the trunk follow.

mistakes.mistake: Throwing the ball at the feet
mistakes.fix: Aim just in front of the toes.
Squat down to the ball with a flat back.

kinematics.peak: Ball centre 190 cm high, shoulders 142° elevation
kinematics.norm: Arms long overhead, trunk tall (standard technique)
Deep hinge and knee bend at the bottom (clinical opinion)
Forceful trunk flexion into the slam (Oliva-Lozano 2020)

kinematics.peak: Touches the floor in front of the feet (lowest 0.0 cm)
kinematics.norm: Held between the hands throughout; touches the floor in front of the feet

kinematics.peak: 0.9 s up, 0.25 s pause, 0.65 s slam, 1.8 s pick-up

sources.title: GymVisual #11444, Medicine Ball Overhead Slam, video (movement reference)
Oliva-Lozano and Muyor 2020, core muscle activity during physical fitness exercises: a systematic review (Int J Environ Res Public Health 17(12):4306)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, numbness or cramping occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Use a dead slam ball made for throwing, not a bouncing medicine ball.
modify: Low-back pain: lighter ball, smaller hinge.

muscleNotes.core: Rectus abdominis flexes the trunk hard into the slam (Oliva-Lozano 2020, dynamic core work).
muscleNotes.lats_r: Pull the arms down from overhead (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.lats_l: Pull the arms down from overhead (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Hinge and stand back up (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Hinge and stand back up (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.triceps_r: Extend the elbows into the throw (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.triceps_l: Extend the elbows into the throw (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.quads_r: Squat down to pick the ball up (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.quads_l: Squat down to pick the ball up (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Protect the back in the pick-up (clinical opinion).
